- Procurement requested DocuSign routing and PO terms: aim to have DocuSign envelope ready by Dec 3
- Requested production start date: Jan 4, 2027 (can be pushed to Jan 11 if procurement needs extra time)
- Canary rollout: 2-week canary starting day 1 of production; scope described in Canary_rollout_plan.pdf

Please confirm the primary signer(s) and whether the billing cadence (Net 30 monthly in SOW) is acceptable. If finance/procurement want a PO-first flow, let me know contact and timeline and we’ll adjust.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP), SOW_draft_v1.pdf (billing & SOW), Canary_rollout_plan.pdf

Next step: if you confirm signers by EOD Monday I’ll route to Legal and Kimberly for a compressed review.

Thanks,
